name: Downtown
description: The Downtown District is the Imperial Capital’s administrative and spiritual core, known for the Sacred Celestianist Cathedral of the Eight and the Municipal Palace, where Lord Mayor Frenzuck and city officials manage civic matters. Though crowds visit the cathedral and Pious Sara Sonata Hospital, the district remains exclusive to noble dwellers, as land ownership is restricted to nobility by imperial decree. Its architecture features mansions with noble and religious symbols. At the same time, the streets have many statues of the gods and sanctified heroes, such as King Malrok and the archangel Ascaran. Apart from nobility, only clerics, acolytes, and priests may reside here, restricted to living on the temple grounds. Given the cathedral’s role as a Celestianist training center, clerical figures are common on the streets. Though short on entertainment and ordinary commerce— usually vetoed by the nobles—the district offers high-end shops. Some even hold Imperial permits to sell magic items exclusively to noble customers.
